breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory sign conventions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the second, incorrect convention. The agent successfully identified this conflict, discarded the incorrect convention (positive shear downward, positive moment as hogging), and correctly and consistently applied the first, standard convention (positive shear upward on the left face, positive moment as sagging). This matches the resolution in the ground truth.
